sloka: एतावत् उक्त्वा वचनम् बाष्प दूषित लोचनः ।बाष्प दूषितया वाचा न उच्चैः श्क्नोति भाषितुम् ॥४-८-२९॥
transliteration: etāvat uktvā vacanam bāṣpa dūṣita locanaḥ ।bāṣpa dūṣitayā vācā na uccaiḥ śknoti bhāṣitum ॥4-8-29॥

translations.english: His vision blurred, words choked with tears he was unable to speak further.
